title: A-S 364 - Introduction to Digital Fabrication
description: This introductory multidisciplinary course explores digital design and fabrication in the context of Laser CNC and 3D printing. The goal of this course is to develop concepts and techniques of CAD modeling to use in 2D and 3D digital processes as they apply to visual art and design. Emphasis will be placed on aesthetics, effective image making, and problem solving. Six Studio hours per week. No prerequisites.
